preActions.injectContext:

LARGE IDEA: evaluate isLargeIdea (multipleIndependentOutcomes || ambiguousOrResearchHeavy || releaseScopeDecomposition || oversizedTaskThatMustSplit) before any spec, task, story or plan. True -> embed the complete large_idea_decomposition block (outcome_slices, dependencies_order, non_goals, risks_evidence, deferred_work_owner) in the owning artifacts and carry its slice IDs downstream. False -> record Decomposition Applicability: EXEMPT with reason and owner. Never create {PRODUCT_ROADMAP_DOC}; a supplied roadmap is read-only context.
RELEASABLE TASK: every task is one independently releasable actor-facing outcome with a complete entry-to-result journey (.claude/skills/shared/releasable-task-contract.md); technical/foundation work is enabling work under it; UI tasks need the full connected multi-view mock-app flow, or a recorded Mockup: SKIPPED by user from the pre-generation scope gate.
RESEARCH & DECISIONS: EVERY research stage requires ask user question tool validation before proceeding. Save artifacts to the plan directory per step. Present 2-4 options with confidence % for each major decision; evaluate the top 3 alternatives before adding any new dependency.
ARCHITECTURE GATES: architecture --mode=scalability (read-only architect sub-agent) and the design-rationale why-review (inline, full mode) form one all-return barrier; a why-review FAIL or a changed trade-off blocks /scenario until the design is revised and both re-run. Apply SYNC:scale-ready-foundation before PLAN1; scale-technique and scenario-stress gates are advisory right-sizing in both directions.
PLANS: PLAN1 (after architecture) is strategic; PLAN2 (after test-spec review) is the ready-to-start implementation plan. /plan --mode=validate is the plan-approved gate.
TAIL: /workflow-review-changes runs INLINE (owns security/performance/production-readiness review, the domain-entity reference refresh and docs-manager --mode=update); /workflow-e2e --source=context is required after it; /test and /workflow-end close the run.
NEW-UI EXPLORE MOCKUP (BEFORE the implementation plan): the work-item --mode=mockup step runs with --explore; its Step 0 owns the scope gate and it runs in the main session only; PLAN2's UI Layout builds on the selected mockup.

workflow-bugfix.description: Systematic debugging and fix workflow with end-to-start debugger trace before fix and an explicit-request-only near-end workflow-e2e handoff
workflow-bugfix.intent: Fix a reported defect at the root cause its end-to-start trace proves, guarded by a regression test that fails without the fix and passes with it.
workflow-bugfix.name: Bug Fix

outcomeGates.when: A canonical spec or test-case artifact governs the affected area, and behavior or a public contract changed or that spec lacked the case the bug exposed

preActions.injectContext:
BUG FIX (lean, TDD-first). Intent: fix the defect at the root cause its end-to-start trace proves, guarded by a regression test that is RED without the fix and GREEN with it. Read .claude/skills/workflow-bugfix/SKILL.md (triage, gates, Code Bug vs Spec Bug gate).
FIRST: triage size (XS/S/M/L/XL), kind and risk per the SKILL.md; the triage selects which optional steps run. Gate steps always run; core and optional steps follow the /start-workflow Step Execution Protocol, one deviation-log line each.
NON-NEGOTIABLE:
- /investigate --mode=debug owns discovery AND root cause (there is no separate read-only /investigate step). END-TO-START TRACE: start at the observed final state/output, trace backward through reader, storage/projection, writer, consumer/job and producer, enumerate every feeder path, build a hypothesis matrix and weigh environment causes. BLOCKED until the owning fix layer and forward convergence proof are written.
- CODE BUG vs SPEC BUG before any regression TC or test: Code Bug (spec right, code diverged) -> TCs for the intended behavior; Spec Bug (spec documents the wrong behavior) -> /spec [mode=amend] first; Ambiguous -> ask the user. Never encode buggy behavior into specs or tests.
- RED/GREEN (verify last): the first /integration-test WRITES the regression test and does not run it; tests run once, after the static /workflow-review-changes --tests=defer, in /integration-test --mode=verify, whose mutation check reverts the fix by hand-edit (never git checkout/restore/stash) and expects the regression test to FAIL (RED), then restores it and the regression and affected tests must PASS (GREEN) in this run. Tests name the Business Intent / Invariant Guarded.
- /workflow-review-changes runs INLINE in the main session and converges the review of the whole package (spec + tests + fix).
PERFORMANCE-SDD ROUTE: a performance bug runs /performance-review with SLA/benchmark evidence (target metric, baseline, measurement command, regression budget); keep functional no-regression checks when behavior can change; update specs/docs for a changed SLA or behavior boundary.
NEW-UI EXPLORE MOCKUP (conditional, BEFORE plan): only when the fix is size M+ and creates completely new user-facing UI (a new page/view, component or dialog); run /work-item --mode=mockup --explore --source=<investigation report or amended spec> — its Step 0 owns the scope gate and it runs in the main session only. A fix inside existing UI skips it with a stated reason.
CONTEXT: shared/sdd-artifact-contract.md in the active skills root, docs/project-config.json and the docs index. Code-extracted specs are reference-only until accepted.

workflow-e2e.description: Write, update, and verify E2E tests using the configured project runner and a bounded green fix/retest loop; visual evidence follows the request and project contract
workflow-e2e.intent: Author or update E2E coverage for the resolved source scope and converge it to green through the project's configured runner.
workflow-e2e.name: E2E Testing

preActions.injectContext:
E2E WORKFLOW — follow .claude/skills/workflow-e2e/SKILL.md (triage, gates, recommended skills).
FIRST: resolve --source={changes|recording|update-ui|prompt|context|whole} and --visual-review={true|false} from the invocation, request, and project contract (no framework-wide screenshot default; a false value cannot waive a project-required gate), then triage size/kind/risk and record it.
Lifecycle: investigate -> conditional authoring (e2e-test for changes, recording, update-ui; skipped for prompt, context, whole because the loop selects or generates cases) -> e2e-test --mode=verify --fix-loop -> docs-manager --mode=update when tests, baselines, source, or documented behavior changed -> workflow-end -> watzup.
The loop is the single convergence owner: configured run, report-only /experience-review for visual evidence, failure classification, owning-layer fixes, review, fresh bring-up, and same-scope reruns until the configured consecutive green runs pass within the round cap, or escalation.
Invariants: map each selected owner-qualified case (or strict-default TC/section 8 when no native specArtifacts profile applies) to an actual test, assertion, and result; classify SOURCE-WRONG, TEST-WRONG, TEST-NOT-OPTIMAL, ENVIRONMENT-BLOCKED, or AMBIGUOUS before edits; use the runner native waits or an evidenced helper, never a delay as readiness; change no baseline or expectation without explicit acceptance; never weaken, skip, narrow, delete, silence, or auto-accept to obtain green.

applicability.when: Resolved --source is changes, recording, or update-ui; write or update the E2E artifact and hand its exact scope to the convergence loop.
applicability.skipReason: Resolved --source is prompt, context, or whole; e2e-test --mode=verify --fix-loop owns scenario selection or generation for that source.

preActions.injectContext: LEAN SPEC-SUPPLIED ROUTE: the requested behavior is already written in a canonical spec or TC set, so this route implements it without re-authoring the spec. Read .claude/skills/workflow-implement-spec/SKILL.md. FIRST ACTION: triage size (XS/S/M/L/XL), kind and risk per the SKILL.md Size & Kind Triage; depth follows risk and ambiguity, and the gap review plus every gate hold at every size. ESCALATION (BR-GWF-04): /investigate reads the supplied spec and affected code, then /spec [mode=clarify] gap-reviews that spec against the request; vague, contradictory, or missing behavior stops before /plan and routes to user clarification or workflow-feature. SPEC-BASELINE ANCHOR (BR-GWF-05): before /plan, the workflow report records the supplied spec path and revision as spec_baseline; /plan keeps every phase and acceptance gate within it, and unowned additions require approval. Author integration tests after implementation, then run one /spec [mode=sync] reconciliation when behavior or case-to-test evidence changed, before the nested /workflow-review-changes. If review fixes invalidate that reconciliation, repeat only the scoped sync before final verification. Tests run only in the final verification gates.

preActions.injectContext:
GREENFIELD INCEPTION: take a new product from idea to a reviewed first releasable slice on a verified foundation. Read .claude/skills/workflow-greenfield-init/SKILL.md before step 1 — it owns triage, the required gates and orchestration; /start-workflow → Step Execution Protocol owns step flex and the deviation log.
TRIAGE FIRST and record it in the run report: scale (prototype/internal · product · platform), UI surface yes/no, commercial market yes/no, criticality (auth, PII, money, regulated), isLargeIdea, and applicable test tiers. Judge every optional step's applicability from that record.
LARGE IDEA: evaluate isLargeIdea = multipleIndependentOutcomes || ambiguousOrResearchHeavy || releaseScopeDecomposition || oversizedTaskThatMustSplit before any spec, task, story or plan. When true, embed the complete large_idea_decomposition block in the owning artifact and carry its stable slice IDs downstream. The roadmap artifact ({PRODUCT_ROADMAP_DOC}) is never a default output here — only an explicit roadmap request routes to its standalone skill; a supplied roadmap is read-only context.
RELEASABLE TASKS: each task is one independently releasable actor-facing outcome with a complete entry-to-result journey; foundation/setup work attaches to it and is never a standalone technical task; UI tasks carry the connected multi-view mock-app surface (.claude/skills/shared/releasable-task-contract.md).
ORDER: business and domain before technology — do not ask for the tech stack upfront; domain analysis (ERD + bounded contexts) precedes tech-stack research. Major decisions show 2-4 options with confidence % and evidence; validate each phase's decisions with the user via ask user question tool and never self-approve a one-way door.
BLOCKING: before the first /plan completes, record the SYNC:scale-ready-foundation matrix and the SYNC:ai-agent-as-user-access decision (or an explicit evidence-backed omission). Before /plan --mode=execute, every Test Architecture & Execution Contract tier is APPLICABLE with runner, copy-ready full and focused commands, zero-match behavior and unique run/data identity — or N/A — <evidence>.
FIXED: /plan --mode=validate, /workflow-review-changes, the final /test and /workflow-end are gates; the final /test is the single unit/system verify and runs after E2E. /workflow-review-changes runs INLINE in the main session. /e2e-test runs only when docs/project-config.json → e2eTesting declares a runnable framework, else N/A — <evidence>. /workflow-e2e --source=context runs after the review and before the final /test and records N/A or ENVIRONMENT-BLOCKED honestly. Tests use the project's native style, name the protected intent or invariant, and fail when it breaks.

REFACTOR (lean, behavior-preserving). Intent: restructure code without changing observable behavior, proven by the same test scope green before and after plus a converged change review. Read .claude/skills/workflow-refactor/SKILL.md (triage, gates).
FIRST: triage size (XS/S/M/L/XL), kind and risk per the SKILL.md; the triage selects which optional steps run. Gate steps always run; core and optional steps follow the /start-workflow Step Execution Protocol, one deviation-log line each.
NON-NEGOTIABLE:
- Search before planning: find the target pattern in 3+ local examples (file:line) and follow docs/project-config.json workflowPatterns (architecture, code hierarchy, naming), not generic framework docs.
- BASELINE: run /test on the affected scope BEFORE any change; it must be green. A red baseline stops the refactor: report it or route the failure to workflow-bugfix. When no existing test would fail if the touched behavior changed, write characterization tests first (/integration-test) and prove them green on the unrefactored code.
- Observable behavior (outputs, persisted state, public contracts, errors, state transitions, timing boundaries) must not change; a change the user explicitly approves turns the work into a feature or bugfix. Test code may change only mechanically (imports, renamed symbols, moved paths); an edited assertion or expected value is a behavior change and needs the user's approval.
- Removing 'unused' code needs /investigate evidence: grep results, confidence >=80%, cross-module/service check.
- /workflow-review-changes runs INLINE in the main session; the final /test gate re-runs the baseline scope and must be green.
PERFORMANCE-SDD ROUTE: a performance-driven refactor runs /performance-review for benchmark evidence (SLA, baseline, measurement command) while preserving observable behavior and functional no-regression; a changed SLA, public contract or docs/spec boundary still requires spec/test/docs sync.
CONTEXT: shared/sdd-artifact-contract.md in the active skills root and docs/project-config.json.

PROFILE FIRST: read docs/project-config.json (specRoots.business.path, workflowPatterns.featureDocTemplate, specArtifacts), the configured template, spec-system-reference.md and spec-principles.md. The native profile or local contract owns paths, section roles, IDs and test/evidence carriers; intent roles stay tech-agnostic. The portable eight-section README + Section 8 TC-{FEATURE}-{NNN} form applies only when neither exists (details: SKILL.md). Unknown mapping = BLOCKED/UNKNOWN, never PASS; a malformed contract blocks.

Spec-Loop Discipline: property cases with boundary counter-cases for every hard invariant; mutation-score gate, not line coverage, for protected core logic; feed uncovered behavior into spec and tests via a dual-feedback ledger.
Tests Verify Intent: every case names the business intent or invariant it guards and would fail if that intent broke. Goal-Driven Execution: define success criteria first; loop until observable checks pass.

preActions.injectContext:
INTEGRATION TESTS (variants write | green): pick `--mode` from the prompt BEFORE creating tasks — `write` (default: author or update spec-traced integration tests for existing code and prove them green; state the assumption when ambiguous) or `green` (a suite or named test is red, flaky or must be proven repeatably green: verify -> adjudicate -> fix -> re-verify). The resolved variant is a complete sequence; build tasks from it and apply ONLY its section below.

VARIANT write (--mode=write):
WRITE INTEGRATION TESTS: write or update integration tests traced to the project's canonical case owner and prove they pass with real assertion value.
PROJECT CONTEXT: read docs/project-config.json -> integrationTestVerify (guidance, commands, test roots) and framework.integrationTestDoc, the selected referenceDocs, and same-area tests; they choose runner, layout, fixtures, waits, annotations and repeat policy. Never assume a language, database, layer layout or helper.
CASE OWNER: resolve specArtifacts and specRoots; use the configured carrier and identifiers, else the strict-default Feature Spec Section 8 TC contract when that is the selected contract. Never invent sections, TC IDs, CoveredBy fields or annotations for a custom carrier.
TRIAGE FIRST (record it): size band (XS 1-3 cases in one suite ... XL whole-suite audit), kind (new coverage, converting existing cases, stabilising a suite, persistent/shared state, UI, security) and case state (missing, stale, current). Optional steps run only when their registry `when` holds; log every other deviation per /start-workflow.
GATES: /integration-test --mode=review performs one evidence-backed review pass over all eight gates, including change coverage and real-world fidelity, then reports and stops; fixes and any later review are caller-owned and require a new explicit invocation. /integration-test --mode=verify is green over the configured suites under integrationTestVerify.guidance (absent: two fresh green runs without destructive reset for persistent/shared-state suites) with real runner output; /spec [mode=sync] reconciles cases with executing tests; /workflow-end closes after the Goal Satisfaction matrix.
GUARDRAILS: read the production and test source before writing any assertion; every test names the invariant it protects and asserts an outcome the system owns; exercise the production entry path when it is the behavior under test and valid fixtures for unrelated preconditions; wait only on a real observable signal. On any failure record a five-way Fault Verdict via /investigate --mode=debug before editing; never force green by deleting or skipping tests, weakening assertions, widening assertion timeouts, retrying assertions or narrowing scope.
Triage table, gates and recommended skills: .claude/skills/workflow-integration-test/references/variant-write.md.

VARIANT green (--mode=green):
INTEGRATION TEST GREEN (verify -> adjudicate -> fix -> re-verify, bounded loop): drive the resolved integration-test scope to repeatable green by fixing each failure at its owning layer.
PROJECT CONTEXT: read docs/project-config.json -> integrationTestVerify (guidance, quickRunCommand, testProjectPattern/testProjects, systemCheckCommand, startupScript) and framework.integrationTestDoc; never hardcode a runner, database, helper or layout.
SCOPE: the WHOLE system by default; a named suite, module, test or diff narrows it. Record the concrete suite list and pass it explicitly every round - never the git-changed subset, never narrowed; widen it (logged) when a source fix reaches suites outside it.
TRIAGE FIRST (record it): failure load after the first verify (0 = proof-only run; XS 1-3 failures sharing a cause = inline; larger = cluster by signature and module, sweep the environment first, adjudicate cluster by cluster in bounded batches) and the verdict kinds. Optional steps run only when their registry `when` holds; log every other deviation per /start-workflow.
LOOP (owned by /integration-test --mode=verify --fix-loop, INLINE): Goal Contract first; each round runs the default verify pass INLINE over the fixed scope; every failure gets ONE Fault Verdict (SOURCE-WRONG | TEST-WRONG | TEST-NOT-OPTIMAL | ENVIRONMENT-BLOCKED | AMBIGUOUS) from /investigate --mode=debug + report-only /integration-test --mode=review BEFORE any edit; /fix at the owning component (SOURCE-WRONG keeps or strengthens the catching test); every round with a fix runs INLINE report-only /changes-review over the fix diff, validates findings with /why-review --validate-findings and folds them into the same round; Round Integrity Check (executed count never shrinks, skipped never grows, scope never narrows); fresh full re-verify. Round cap 3 -> escalate via ask user question tool on no progress across 2 rounds, more failures, lost coverage, an open validated finding, ENVIRONMENT-BLOCKED or AMBIGUOUS. Investigation and fixes happen only inside the loop (no workflow-level /investigate --mode=debug or /fix step) - never a second fix loop after it returns.
GUARDRAIL - NEVER force green: no weakened or removed assertions, skips, widened assertion timeouts, retried assertions, mutated unrelated persistent data or narrowed scope. Every pass/fail claim cites runner output.
AFTER CONVERGENCE: sync the configured case owner (strict default: Feature Spec Section 8 TCs + CoveredBy; custom profile: its declared carrier and fields), then /docs-manager --mode=update - its impact map verifies the integration-test reference and other docs and escalates to /scan --target=integration-tests only when that reference needs a rebuild.
